name: r134a_heat_pump_effectiveness
title: R134a heat pump with effectiveness heat exchangers
summary: R134a heat-pump cycle whose evaporator and condenser are effectiveness-capacitance exchangers (Alpha, Beta in W/K): the evaporation and condensation temperatures float with the outdoor and building air temperatures. Isentropic compressor (0.60) sized by a fixed suction volumetric flow; COP vs outdoor temperature.

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution (capvst.ees, T_amb = 15 °C run) after subtracting the documented R134a reference-state offsets (+148.1 kJ/kg, +0.796 kJ/kg-K): 27 common variables, max rel. diff 1.28e-03 (T[1], EES vs CoolProp properties); parametric-table row T_amb = -15 °C checked by hand: max 3.68e-04 (Q_H).
verification.reference: EES stored solution and parametric Table 1 (7 runs, T_amb -15..15 °C) of ~/Nextcloud/thermo_models/EES_library/capvst.ees
verification.notes: h/s compared after reference-state shift (CoolProp-EES = +148.1 kJ/kg, +0.796 kJ/kg-K, ees_import §11); raw comparison shows 6.24e-01 on absolute h/s. Remaining 1.28e-03 on T[1] (0.13 %) is within the 0.5 % tolerance for different R134a formulations.
